title: Estimating Macrofiscal Effects of Climate Shocks from Billions of Geospatial Weather Observations
abstract: The literature studying the macroeconomics of weather has focused on temperature and precipitation annual averages, while micro studies have focused more on extreme weather measures. We construct hundreds of variables from high-frequency, high-spatial-resolution weather measurements. Using the LASSO, we identify the parsimonious subset of variables that can best explain GDP and key macrofiscal variables. We find that scarcer mild temperatures and an increase in the occurrence of high temperatures and severe droughts reduce GDP. These variables substantially improve the share of GDP variations explained by weather. Additional evidence suggests that fiscal policy mitigates these shocks. (JEL E23, E62, O44, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 研究天气宏观经济学的文献主要关注温度和降水的年平均值，而微观研究则更多关注极端天气指标。我们从高频、高空间分辨率的气象观测数据中构建了数百个变量。利用LASSO方法，我们识别出能够最好解释GDP和关键宏观财政变量的精简变量子集。研究发现，温和气温的减少以及高温和严重干旱发生频率的增加会降低GDP。这些变量显著提高了天气因素可以解释的GDP变动比例。补充证据表明，财政政策能够缓解这些冲击。（JEL E23, E62, O44, Q54, Q56）

title: Climate Variability and Worldwide Migration: Empirical Evidence and Projections
abstract: We estimate a bilateral gravity equation for emigration rates controlling for decadal weather averages of temperature, precipitation, droughts, and extreme precipitation in origin countries. Using the parameter estimates of the gravity equation, we estimate global, regional, and country-by-country emigration flows using different population and climate scenarios. Global emigration flows are projected to increase between 73 and 91 million in 2030-2039; between 83 and 102 million in 2040-2049; between 88 and 121 in 2050-59, and between 87 and 133 million in 2060-2069. Changes in emigration flows are mainly due to population growth in the origin countries.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了一个双边引力方程，用于解释移民率，并控制了原籍国的温度、降水、干旱和极端降水的年代平均值。利用引力方程的参数估计结果，我们在不同的人口和气候情景下，估计了全球、区域以及各国逐国的移民流动。预计2030至2039年全球移民流动将增加7,300万至9,100万人；2040至2049年将增加8,300万至1.02亿人；2050至2059年将增加8,800万至1.21亿人，2060至2069年将增加8,700万至1.33亿人。移民流动的变化主要源于原籍国的人口增长。

title: The Effect of Temperature on the Incidence Rate of COVID19
abstract: In this paper, we exploit random variation of daily temperature in the United States at both state and county level, from March 1st to October 31st 2020, to study if temperature has a significant effect on COVID19 incidence rate. We find that warmer than average days lead to a lower incidence rate, seven days later. A week in which temperature is consistently one standard deviation above the monthly average in all US states causes 17,754 fewer cases at national level, seven days later. Other weather variables do not have a significant and robust effect on the incidence rate. The effect of temperature is heterogeneous over space and time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2020年3月1日至10月31日美国州和县两级每日气温的随机变化，研究气温是否对新冠病毒感染率有显著影响。我们发现，比平均水平温暖的日子会在七天后导致感染率下降。如果在一周内，全美各州的气温持续比月平均水平高出一个标准差，则七天后全国将减少17,754例病例。其他天气变量对感染率没有显著且稳健的影响。气温的影响在空间和时间上具有异质性。

title: Temperature thresholds and the effect of warming on American farmland value
Does Harmful Climate Increase Or Decrease Migration? Evidence From Rural Households In Nigeria
abstract: This paper analyzes whether migration is an adaptation strategy that households employ to cope with climate in Nigeria. We estimate our model using the cross-sectional variation in climate and long-term migration decisions because we are interested in the average response to long-term climatic conditions. For households that operate farms, we find that the relationship between climate and migration is nonlinear. In particular, climates closer to ideal farming conditions are associated with a higher propensity to migrate, whereas in the least favorable climatic conditions, the propensity to migrate declines. The marginal effect of rainfall and temperature changes on migration varies by season. We estimate the impact of climate change on the number of migrant households in 2031–2060 and 2071–2100, ceteris paribus. With current population levels, climate change generates between 3.6 and 6.3 million additional migrants, most of them being internal. However, these estimates are not statistically significant.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了迁移是否是尼日利亚家庭为应对气候而采取的一种适应策略。我们利用气候的横截面差异和长期迁移决策来估计模型，因为我们关注的是对长期气候条件的平均反应。对于从事农业生产的家庭，我们发现气候与迁移之间呈非线性关系。具体而言，越接近理想农业生产条件的气候，迁移倾向越高；而在最不利的气候条件下，迁移倾向则下降。降雨和气温变化对迁移的边际效应因季节而异。在其他条件不变的情况下，我们估计了气候变化对2031至2060年以及2071至2100年迁移家庭数量的影响。以当前人口水平计算，气候变化将新增360万至630万移民，其中大部分为国内迁移。然而，这些估计在统计上并不显著。

title: A Ricardian analysis of the impact of climate change on Italian agriculture
Measuring Climate Adaptation: Methods and Evidence
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article examines methods for measuring climate adaptation and discusses the empirical evidence. The primary methods for measuring climate adaptation are cross-sectional analysis, simulations, and intertemporal panel data. The empirical evidence in the literature suggests that adaptation can be effective at eliminating a large fraction of potential damage from changes in mean climate but not short-term climate variation. Much of the adaptation will likely be incremental and reactive, responding to climate as it changes over time. Private actors have their own incentives to adapt to climate change and are likely to change their behavior if it makes them better off. But government action is needed to ensure that markets are efficient and to support public adaptations, especially those related to water supply, coastal defense, human health, and environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 本文考察衡量气候适应的方法，并讨论相关实证证据。衡量气候适应的主要方法包括横截面分析、模拟以及跨期面板数据。文献中的实证证据表明，适应能够有效消除由平均气候变化带来的大部分潜在损害，但对短期气候波动的消除作用有限。大部分适应行动可能是渐进式和被动式的，会随着气候随时间变化而作出反应。私人主体有自身的适应动机，如果调整行为能使其受益，他们很可能会改变行为。但政府行动对于确保市场有效运行以及支持公共适应措施是必要的，特别是与供水、海岸防御、人类健康和环境保护相关的措施。

title: Is Western European Agriculture Resilient to High Temperatures?
Investments in and Macroeconomic Costs of Climate Mitigation in the Working Group III Contribution to the Fifth Assessment Report of the IPCC
The Use of Cross-Sectional Analysis to Measure Climate Impacts on Agriculture: Theory and Evidence
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article examines the methodological issues associated with using cross-sectional methods to study climate impacts on agriculture. In particular, we describe and address concerns that have been raised about this method, including missing variable bias, irrigation, prices, and carbon fertilization. We review cross-sectional studies of estimated climate impacts on agriculture around the world. These studies suggest that both temperature and precipitation have modest effects on farmland value and net revenue. The studies also suggest that marginal warming will likely be harmful in low latitudes but beneficial in higher latitudes and that marginal increases in rainfall will be beneficial in semiarid locations but harmful in very wet places. The impacts differ for rain-fed versus irrigated farms and for crops versus livestock. The results imply that global warming will likely have only modest impacts on global food production for the next century since the harm from higher temperatures will likely be offset by the benefits of carbon fertilization and adaptations by farmers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察使用横截面方法研究气候对农业影响时所涉及的方法论问题。特别是，我们描述并回应了针对该方法提出的若干质疑，包括遗漏变量偏误、灌溉、价格以及碳施肥效应。我们回顾了全球范围内关于气候对农业影响的横截面研究。这些研究表明，温度和降水对农田价值和净收益的影响都较为温和。研究还表明，在低纬度地区，边际增温可能有害，而在高纬度地区则可能有益；在半干旱地区，边际增雨有益，而在非常湿润的地区则有害。影响因雨养农田与灌溉农田、以及作物与牲畜而有所不同。结果表明，全球变暖对未来一个世纪的全球粮食产量可能只有温和的影响，因为高温带来的危害可能会被碳施肥效应以及农民的适应行为所抵消。

title: U.S. Sulfur Dioxide Emission Reductions: Contributing Factors and a Carbon Dioxide Penalty
How well do degree days over the growing season capture the effect of climate on farmland values?
Quantifying the Ancillary Benefits of the Representative Concentration Pathways on Air Quality in Europe
abstract: This paper presents estimates of the economic benefit of air quality improvements in Europe that occur as a side effect of GHG emission reductions. We consider three climate policy scenarios that reach radiative forcing levels in 2100 of three Representative Concentration Pathways (RCPs). These targets are achieved by introducing a global uniform tax on all GHG emissions in the Integrated Assessment Model WITCH, assuming both full as well as limited technological flexibility. The resulting consumption patterns of fossil fuels are used to estimate the physical impacts and the economic benefits of pollution reductions on human health and on key assets by implementing the most advanced version of the ExternE methodology with its Impact Pathway Analysis. We find that the mitigation scenario compatible with 2°C reduces total pollution costs in Europe by 76%. Discounted ancillary benefits are more than €2.5 trillion between 2015 and 2100. The monetary value of reduced pollution is equal to €22 per abated ton of CO2 in Europe. Less strict climate policy scenarios generate overall smaller, but still considerable, local benefits (14 € or 18 € per abated ton of CO2). Without discounting, the ancillary benefits are in a range of €36 to €50 per ton of CO2 abated. Cumulative ancillary benefits exceed the cumulative additional cost of electricity generation in Europe. Each European country alone would be better off if the mitigation policy was implemented, although the local benefits in absolute terms vary significantly across the countries. We can identify the relative losers and winners of ancillary benefits in Europe. In particular, we find that large European countries contribute to as much as they benefit from ancillary benefits. The scenarios with limited technology flexibility do deliver results that are similar to the full technology flexibility scenario.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了温室气体减排附带产生的欧洲空气质量改善的经济效益。我们考虑了三种气候政策情景，其2100年的辐射强迫水平分别达到三种代表性浓度路径（RCP）的目标。这些目标是在综合评估模型WITCH中通过对所有温室气体排放征收全球统一的税来实现的，并假设技术灵活性既可以是完全的，也可以是有限的。由此产生的化石燃料消费模式，被用于估算污染减少对人类健康和关键资产的物理影响及经济效益，所采用的是ExternE方法最先进的版本及其影响路径分析。我们发现，符合2°C目标的减缓情景使欧洲的总污染成本降低了76%。2015至2100年间，折现后的附带效益超过2.5万亿欧元。减少的污染的货币价值相当于欧洲每减排一吨二氧化碳获得22欧元的收益。较不严格的气候政策情景产生的整体效益较小，但仍相当可观（每减排一吨二氧化碳获得14欧元或18欧元的本地效益）。不进行折现时，附带效益为每减排一吨二氧化碳36至50欧元。累计附带效益超过了欧洲电力生产的累计额外成本。每个欧洲国家单独来看，如果实施减缓政策都会受益，尽管各国本地效益的绝对规模差异显著。我们识别出了欧洲附带效益中的相对输家和赢家。特别是，我们发现欧洲大国对附带效益的贡献与其获益几乎相当。技术灵活性有限的情景所得结果与完全技术灵活性情景相似。

title: The Macroeconomics of Climate Policy: Investments and Financial Flows
venue: Towards a Workable and Effective Climate Regime

title: A Climate-Constrained World
venue: Climate Change Mitigation, Technological Innovation and Adaptation: A New Perspective on Climate Policy

title: Trade of woody biomass for electricity generation under climate mitigation policy
abstract: Bio-energy has the potential to be a key mitigation option if combined with carbon capture and sequestration (BECCS) because it generates electricity and absorbs emissions at the same time. However, biomass is not distributed evenly across the globe, and regions with a potentially high demand might be constrained by limited domestic supply. Therefore, climate mitigation policies might create the incentive to trade biomass internationally. This paper uses scenarios generated by the integrated assessment model WITCH to study trade of woody biomass from multiple perspectives: the volume of biomass traded, its value, the impact on other power generation technologies and on marginal abatement costs. The policy scenarios consist of three representative carbon tax policies (4.8 W/m2, 3.8 W/m2 and 3.2 W/m2 radiative forcing in 2100) and a cap-and-trade scheme (3.8 W/m2 in 2100). Results show that the incentive to trade biomass is high: at least 50% of biomass consumed globally is from the international market. Regions trade 13-69 EJ/yr of woody biomass in 2050 and 55-81 EJ/yr in 2100. In 2100 the value of biomass traded is equal to US$ 0.7-7.2 Trillion. Trade of woody biomass sensibly reduces marginal abatement costs. In the tax scenarios, abatement increases by 120-323 Gt CO2 over the century. In the cap-and-trade scenario biomass trade reduces the price of emission allowances by 34% in 2100 and cumulative discounted policy costs by 14%.
abstract_zh: 生物能源如果与碳捕集与封存（BECCS）相结合，有可能成为一种关键的减缓选择，因为它既能发电，又能同时吸收排放。然而，生物质在全球范围内分布不均，一些潜在需求较高的地区可能受到国内供应有限的制约。因此，气候减缓政策可能会激励生物质的国际贸易。本文利用综合评估模型WITCH生成的情景，从多个角度研究木质生物质的贸易：贸易量、价值、对其他发电技术的影响以及对边际减排成本的影响。政策情景包括三种代表性的碳税政策（2100年辐射强迫分别为4.8 W/m²、3.8 W/m²和3.2 W/m²）以及一种总量控制与交易方案（2100年为3.8 W/m²）。结果表明，生物质贸易的激励很强：全球消费的生物质至少有50%来自国际市场。2050年，各地区贸易的木质生物质为13至69 EJ/年；2100年为55至81 EJ/年。2100年，交易的生物质价值为0.7至7.2万亿美元。生物质贸易显著降低了边际减排成本。在碳税情景下，整个世纪的减排量增加了120至323亿吨二氧化碳。在总量控制与交易情景下，生物质贸易使2100年排放配额价格下降34%，并使累计折现政策成本降低14%。

title: Should We Ban Unconventional Oil Extraction to Reduce Global Warming?
abstract: The extraction and processing of unconventional oil is more energy intensive and has larger negative environmental impacts than the extraction of conventional oil. The European Union (EU) estimates that oil sands lead to 22% more emissions than conventional oil. The EU is very concerned by the potential climate and environmental impacts and has considered introducing a tax on imported unconventional oil in order to discourage its production. This study shows that a global ban on the use of unconventional oil substantially reduces global carbon dioxide emissions, but the policy is not efficient. A unilateral ban of the EU on unconventional oil has no climate benefits and it is expensive for Europe.
abstract_zh: 非常规石油的开采和加工比常规石油的开采能耗更高，对环境的负面影响也更大。欧盟估计，油砂产生的排放比常规石油高出22%。欧盟非常关注其可能带来的气候和环境影响，并考虑对进口非常规石油征税，以抑制其生产。本研究表明，全球禁止使用非常规石油可大幅减少全球二氧化碳排放，但该政策效率不高。欧盟单方面禁止非常规石油对气候没有益处，而且对欧洲而言代价高昂。

title: An assessment of the optimal timing and size of investments in concentrated solar power
Incentives and stability of international climate coalitions: An integrated assessment
abstract: This paper analyses the incentives to participate in and the stability of international climate coalitions. Using the integrated assessment model WITCH, the analysis of coalitions’ profitability and stability is performed under alternative assumptions concerning the pure rate of time preference, the social welfare aggregator and the extent of climate damages. We focus on the profitability, stability, and “potential stability” of a number of coalitions which are “potentially effective” in reducing emissions. We find that only the grand coalition under a specific sets of assumptions finds it optimal to stabilize GHG concentration below 550 ppm CO2-eq. However, the grand coalition is found not to be stable, not even “potentially stable” even through an adequate set of transfers. However, there exist potentially stable coalitions, but of smaller size, which are also potentially environmentally effective. Depending on the assumptions made, they could achieve up to 600 ppm CO2-eq. More ambitious targets lead to the collapse of the coalition.
abstract_zh: 本文分析国际气候联盟的参与激励和稳定性。利用综合评估模型WITCH，我们在纯时间偏好率、社会福利加总方式以及气候损害程度等不同假设下，分析了各联盟的盈利能力和稳定性。我们关注一些“可能有效”减排的联盟的盈利能力、稳定性以及“潜在稳定性”。我们发现，在某些特定假设下，只有大联盟认为将温室气体浓度稳定在550 ppm CO₂当量以下是最优的。然而，大联盟被发现并不稳定，即使通过适当的转移支付也不具备“潜在稳定性”。不过，存在一些规模较小但具有潜在稳定性的联盟，它们同样在潜在上具有环境有效性。根据所作假设的不同，这些联盟可以实现高达600 ppm CO₂当量的目标。更雄心勃勃的目标则会导致联盟瓦解。

title: International Climate Treaties and Coalition Building
A developing Asia emission trading scheme (Asia ETS)
Beyond Copenhagen: a realistic climate policy in a fragmented world
abstract: We propose a realistic approach to climate policy based on the Copenhagen Agreement to reduce Greenhouse Gases (GHGs) emissions. We assess by how much the non-binding, although official, commitments to reduce emissions made in Copenhagen will affect the level of world GHGs emissions in 2020. Our estimates are based on official communications to the UNFCCC, on historic data and on the Business-as-Usual scenario of the WITCH model. We are not interested in estimating the gap between the expected level of emissions and what would be needed to achieve the 2°C target. Nor do we attempt to calculate the 2100 temperature level implied by the Copenhagen pledges. We believe these two exercises are subject to high uncertainty and would not improve the current state of negotiations. Rather, we take stock of the present politically achievable level of commitment and suggest an effective way to push forward the climate policy agenda. The focus is on what can be done rather than on what should be done. To this end, we estimate the potential of the financial provisions of the Copenhagen Agreement to sponsor mitigation effort in Non-Annex I countries. Using scenarios produced with the WITCH model, we show that lower commitment on domestic abatement measures can be compensated by devoting roughly 50% of the Copenhagen financial provisions in 2020 to mitigation in Non-Annex I countries. The policy implications of our results will be discussed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种基于《哥本哈根协议》的现实主义气候政策方法，以减少温室气体（GHG）排放。我们评估哥本哈根承诺（虽无约束力，但属官方承诺）的减排承诺将在多大程度上影响2020年全球温室气体排放水平。我们的估计基于向《联合国气候变化框架公约》提交的官方材料、历史数据以及WITCH模型的一切照旧（BAU）情景。我们并不关心估算预期排放水平与实现2°C目标所需排放水平之间的差距，也不试图计算哥本哈根承诺所隐含的2100年温度水平。我们认为，这两项工作都存在很高的不确定性，且不会改善当前的谈判状况。相反，我们评估当前政治上可实现的承诺水平，并提出一种有效的方式推动气候政策议程前进。重点在于什么是可以做到的，而非什么应当做到。为此，我们估算了《哥本哈根协议》的资金安排在资助非附件一国家减缓努力方面的潜力。利用WITCH模型生成的情景，我们表明：只要将2020年《哥本哈根协议》资金安排的大约50%用于非附件一国家的减缓，就可以弥补国内减排措施承诺的不足。我们将讨论研究结果的政策含义。

title: Energy and climate change in China
abstract: The paper examines future energy and emissions scenarios in China, presenting historical data and scenarios generated using the Integrated Assessment Model WITCH. A Business-as-Usual scenario is compared with four scenarios in which Greenhouse Gases emissions are taxed, at different levels. Key insights are provided to evaluate the Chinese pledge to reduce the emissions intensity of Gross Domestic Product by 40/45 percent in 2020 contained in the Copenhagen Accord. Marginal and total abatement costs are discussed using the OECD economies as a term of comparison. Cost estimates for different emissions reduction targets are used to assess the political feasibility of the 50 percent global reduction target set by the G8 and Major Economies Forum in July 2009.
abstract_zh: 本文考察中国未来的能源和排放情景，既呈现历史数据，也展示利用综合评估模型WITCH生成的情景。一切照旧情景被与四种对温室气体排放征收不同水平税收的情景进行比较。本文提供了关键洞见，用以评估中国在《哥本哈根协议》中提出的到2020年单位GDP碳排放强度下降40%至45%承诺的可行性。以经合组织经济体作为对照，讨论了边际减排成本和总减排成本。减排目标的成本估算用于评估2009年7月八国集团和主要经济体论坛提出的全球减排50%目标的政治可行性。

title: Investments and public finance in a green, low carbon, economy
National GHG emissions reduction pledges and 2°C: comparison of studies
abstract: This article provides further detail on expected global GHG emission levels in 2020, based on the Emissions Gap Report (United Nations Environment Programme, December 2010), assuming the emission reduction proposals in the Copenhagen Accord and Cancun Agreements are met. Large differences are found in the results of individual groups owing to uncertainties in current and projected emission estimates and in the interpretation of the reduction proposals. Regardless of these uncertainties, the pledges for 2020 are expected to deliver emission levels above those that are consistent with a 2°C limit. This emissions gap could be narrowed through implementing the more stringent conditional pledges, minimizing the use of ‘lenient’ credits from forests and surplus emission units, avoiding double-counting of offsets and implementing measures beyond current pledges. Conversely, emission reduction gains from countries moving from their low to high ambition pledges could be more than offset by the use of ‘lenient’ land use, land-use change and forestry (LULUCF) credits and surplus emissions units, if these were used to the maximum. Laying the groundwork for faster emission reduction rates after 2020 appears to be crucial in any case.
abstract_zh: 本文基于《排放差距报告》（联合国环境规划署，2010年12月）进一步详细阐述了2020年全球温室气体排放水平的预期，假设《哥本哈根协议》和《坎昆协议》中的减排提议得以实现。由于当前及预计排放量的不确定性，以及对减排提议解释的不同，各研究小组的结果差异很大。尽管存在这些不确定性，2020年的承诺预计仍将使排放水平高于与2°C限值相一致的水平。若实施更严格的有条件承诺，尽量减少“宽松”的森林碳信用和剩余排放单位的使用，避免抵消项目的重复计算，并在现有承诺之外采取进一步措施，这一排放差距可以缩小。相反，若最大限度地使用“宽松”的土地利用、土地利用变化和林业（LULUCF）信用以及剩余排放单位，那么各国从低雄心承诺转向高雄心承诺所带来的减排收益可能被完全抵消，甚至更多。无论如何，为2020年后更快的减排速度奠定基础似乎至关重要。

title: Short‐term and long‐term climate mitigation policy in Italy
abstract:
This article briefly discusses climate mitigation policy in Italy. It first reviews the recent policy action and then assesses the challenges ahead. It shows that emissions in 2012 will be below the Kyoto target only if the carbon intensity of the economies continues to decline at the pre‐crisis rate. Even in this favorable case, the use of Kyoto mechanisms will likely be necessary to compensate for the high emissions of 2008. This article then examines the implications of reducing emissions in 2050 by 80% with respect to the present level, as proposed by Major Economies Leaders during the 2009 G8 meeting. In particular, the article focuses on the transformations needed in the power sector. Scenarios developed using the integrated assessment model World Induced Hybrid Technical Change (WITCH) and an analysis of historical data show that (1) electricity in 2050 must come with zero (or possibly negative) emissions, and therefore, absent nuclear power and (2) carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) must play a major role in future power supply, even with a massive development of wind and photovoltaic. The article then proposes five pillars on which a sensible, long‐term, ambitious Italian climate mitigation policy should rest.WIREs Clim Change2012, 3:171–183. doi: 10.1002/wcc.159
This article is categorized under:
The Carbon Economy and Climate Mitigation > Policies, Instruments, Lifestyles, Behavior
Policy and Governance > National Climate Change Policy
abstract_zh: 本文简要讨论意大利的气候减缓政策。文章首先回顾近期的政策行动，然后评估未来面临的挑战。研究表明，只有在碳强度继续以危机前的速度下降的情况下，2012年的排放量才会低于《京都议定书》目标。即使在这一有利情况下，仍可能需要利用《京都议定书》机制来弥补2008年的高排放。随后，本文考察了按照2009年八国集团会议上主要经济体领导人提出的目标，到2050年相较于当前水平减排80%的含义。特别是，文章关注电力部门所需的转型。利用综合评估模型WITCH（世界诱导混合技术变革模型）生成的情景以及对历史数据的分析表明：（1）2050年的电力必须实现零排放（或可能是负排放），因此在没有核电的情况下；（2）碳捕集与封存（CCS）必须在未来的电力供应中发挥主要作用，即使风能和光伏大规模发展也是如此。文章随后提出了意大利一项审慎、长期且雄心勃勃的气候减缓政策应当依托的五大支柱。WIREs Clim Change 2012, 3:171–183. doi: 10.1002/wcc.159 本文归类于：气候经济与气候减缓 > 政策、工具、生活方式、行为；政策与治理 > 国家气候变化政策

title: Carbon tax scenarios for China and India: exploring politically feasible mitigation goals

title: Estimating Ricardian Models With Panel Data
The Cost Of Climate Change Mitigation Policy In Eastern Europe And Former Soviet Union
abstract: This paper provides one of the few assessments of the economic implications of climate change policies in the important region of Eastern Europe and post-Soviet states. We use an integrated assessment model to evaluate the consequences of implementing climate policies consistent with the targets proposed by the Major Economies Forum by mid-century. We decompose the economic impacts in terms of domestic abatement costs, of oil trading and of international emission permit trading for a variety of scenarios, and show that these could be substantial for this region. The results point towards innovation and economic diversification as key complementary measures to be implemented in preparation of climate mitigation strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文对东欧和前苏联国家这一重要地区的气候变化政策经济影响进行了少有的评估之一。我们利用一个综合评估模型，评估实施符合主要经济体论坛提出的、于本世纪中叶达成目标的气候政策所产生的后果。我们将经济影响分解为国内减排成本、石油贸易成本以及国际排放许可交易的影响，并针对多种情景进行分析，结果表明这些影响对该地区可能相当可观。研究结果指出，创新和经济多元化是在制定减缓战略时需要配套实施的关键补充措施。

title: The Impact of Climate Change on US Agriculture: a Cross-Section, Multi-Period, Ricardian Analysis
venue: Handbook on Climate Change and Agriculture

title: Environmental Policy and Technical Change: A Survey
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: In this survey we review the literature that studies the relationship between environmental policy and technical change. We divide the literature in two broad areas of research. First, we look at the studies that evaluate the impact of environmental regulation on technological change after the implementation of environmental policy (ex-post). Second, we introduce the studies that assess the impact of environmental regulation on innovation dynamics before the implementation of environmental policy (ex-ante). While the first group is dominated by econometric work, in the second group we find the fast growing literature based on Integrated Assessment Models (IAMs) created to study the policies to limit global warming. Both ex-post and ex-ante studies corroborate the hypothesis that environmental policy plays an important role in inducing innovation and in increasing the adoption as well as the diffusion of new technologies. Policy experiments carried out using Integrated Assessment Models highlight that the size and the direction of the inducement effect depend on at least three elements. First, relative prices play an important role, but also scale and market size effects are relevant in shaping incentives to innovate. Second, the inducement effect can vary across different R&D programs and with the degree of policy stringency. Third, nearly all studies stress the role of substitution in terms of flexibility, either within the energy sector, between energy and other inputs such as labour or capital, or between final sectors with different energy intensities. A relevant lesson that should be communicated to policy makers is the importance of combining efficiently policies to address the environmental and the knowledge externalities. Areas in which there is room for more research are mentioned throughout the survey. They include the need of exploiting better cross-country dimension of recent panel data sets, launching a new comprehensive assessment of the determinants of eco-friendly innovation in developing countries, assessing the interactions between "clean" and "dirty" R&D, testing whether firms are operating at the frontier of efficiency or not.
abstract_zh: 本综述梳理了研究环境政策与技术变革之间关系的文献。我们将文献分为两大研究领域。第一，考察环境规制实施之后（事后）对技术变革影响的研究。第二，介绍在环境政策实施之前（事前）评估环境规制对创新动态影响的研究。第一类文献以计量经济学研究为主；第二类文献则以快速发展的综合评估模型（IAMs）研究为主，这些模型是为研究限制全球变暖的政策而建立的。事后和事前研究都证实，环境政策在引导创新以及促进新技术的采用和扩散方面发挥着重要作用。利用综合评估模型进行的政策试验表明，诱导效应的大小和方向取决于至少三个因素。第一，相对价格发挥重要作用，但规模效应和市场规模效应在塑造创新激励方面同样相关。第二，诱导效应在不同研发计划之间以及随政策严格程度的不同而变化。第三，几乎所有研究都强调了替代弹性的作用，包括能源部门内部的替代、能源与劳动或资本等其他投入之间的替代，以及能源强度不同的终端部门之间的替代。政策制定者应当认识到的一个重要教训是，必须有效地结合各类政策，以同时应对环境外部性和知识外部性。综述各处提到了若干值得进一步研究的领域，包括：利用近期面板数据集更好的跨国维度；对发展中国家生态友好型创新的决定因素进行新的全面评估；评估“清洁”与“肮脏”研发之间的相互作用；检验企业是否在效率前沿上运行。

title: International Climate Change Negotiations: Lessons from Theory
abstract: Climate Change Policies sheds light on the foundations, design and effects of climate change policies. Written by leading international experts in the field, this book deals with the various economic effects from climate change policies introduced at national and international levels. It also expertly describes actual applications of climate change policies in the main emitting countries. This insightful study includes chapters on public policies and climate change impacts, adaptation, mitigation, effects on competitiveness, new technologies, distributional concerns, and the international dimension.
abstract_zh: 《气候变化政策》阐明了气候变化政策的基础、设计及其效果。本书由该领域国际知名专家撰写，探讨了在国家和国际层面实施的气候变化政策所产生的各种经济效应。书中还系统地描述了主要排放国家中气候变化政策的实际应用。本书的深入研究包括以下章节：公共政策与气候变化影响、适应、减缓、对竞争力的影响、新技术、分配问题以及国际维度。

title: A Numerical Analysis of Optimal Extraction and Trade of Oil under Climate Policy
The Optimal Climate Policy Portfolio when Knowledge Spills across Sectors
abstract: This paper studies the implications for climate policy of the interactions between environmental and knowledge externalities. Using a numerical analysis performed with the hybrid integrated assessment model WITCH, extended to include mutual spillovers between the energy and the non-energy sector, we show that the combination between environmental and knowledge externalities provides a strong rationale for implementing a portfolio of policies for both emissions reduction and the internalisation of knowledge externalities. Moreover, we show that implementing technology policy as a substitute for stabilisation policy is likely to increase global emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究环境外部性与知识外部性之间的相互作用对气候政策的影响。我们利用混合型综合评估模型WITCH进行数值分析，并将其扩展为纳入能源部门与非能源部门之间的相互溢出效应，结果表明，环境外部性与知识外部性的结合为同时实施减排政策和内部化知识外部性的政策组合提供了有力依据。此外，我们表明，以技术政策替代稳定化政策，很可能会增加全球排放。

title: Banking permits: Economic efficiency and distributional effects
How Does Climate Policy Affect Technical Change? An Analysis of the Direction and Pace of Technical Progress in a Climate-Economy Model
abstract: This paper analyses whether and how a climate policy designed to stabilize greenhouse gases in the atmosphere is likely to change the direction and pace of technical progress. The analysis is performed using an upgraded version of WITCH, a dynamic integrated regional model of the world economy. In this version, a non-energy R&D sector, which enhances the productivity of the capital-labor aggregate, has been added to the energy R&D sector included in the original WITCH model. We find that, as a consequence of climate policy, R&D is re-directed towards energy knowledge. Nonetheless, total R&D investments decrease, due to a more than proportional contraction of non-energy R&D. Indeed, when non-energy and energy inputs are weakly substitutable, the overall contraction of the economic activity associated with a climate policy induces a decline in total R&D investments. However, enhanced investments in energy R&D and in the energy sector are found not to “crowd-out” investments in nonenergy R&D.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了旨在稳定大气温室气体浓度的气候政策，是否以及如何可能改变技术进步的方向和速度。分析采用了WITCH模型的升级版本，这是一个动态的区域综合模型，用于刻画世界经济。在该版本中，除原始WITCH模型中已包含的能源研发部门外，还增加了一个非能源研发部门，该部门提高资本—劳动复合要素的生产率。我们发现，气候政策的结果是研发资源被重新引导至能源领域的知识。然而，研发投资总额下降，原因是非能源研发的收缩幅度超过了比例。事实上，当非能源投入与能源投入之间的替代性较弱时，气候政策带来的整体经济活动收缩会导致研发投资总额下降。不过，能源研发和能源部门的投资增加，并未对非能源研发投资产生“挤出”效应。

title: Optimal energy investment and R&D strategies to stabilize atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations
abstract: The stabilisation of GHG atmospheric concentrations at levels expected to prevent dangerous climate change has become an important, global, long-term objective. It is therefore crucial to identify a cost-effective way to achieve this objective. In this paper we use WITCH, a hybrid climate-energy-economy model, to obtain a quantitative assessment of some cost-effective strategies that stabilise CO2 concentrations at 550 or 450 ppm. In particular, this paper analyses the energy investment and R&D policies that optimally achieve these two GHG stabilisation targets (i.e. the future optimal energy mix consistent with the stabilisation of GHG atmospheric concentrations at 550 and 450 ppm). Given that the model accounts for interdependencies and spillovers across 12 regions of the world, optimal strategies are the outcome of a dynamic game through which inefficiency costs induced by global strategic interactions can be assessed. Therefore, our results are somehow different from previous analyses of GHG stabilisation policies, where a central planner or a single global economy are usually assumed. In particular, the effects of free-riding incentives in reducing emissions and in investing in R&D are taken into account. Technical change being endogenous in WITCH, this paper also provides an assessment of the implications of technological evolution in the energy sector of different stabilisation scenarios. Finally, this paper quantifies the net costs of stabilising GHG concentrations at different levels, for different allocations of permits and for different technological scenarios. In each case, the optimal long-term investment strategies for all available energy technologies are determined. The case of an unknown backstop energy technology is also analysed.
abstract_zh: 将大气温室气体浓度稳定在可预防危险气候变化水平，已成为一项重要的全球性长期目标。因此，确定实现这一目标的成本最低的途径至关重要。本文利用WITCH模型（一个混合型气候—能源—经济模型），对能够将二氧化碳浓度稳定在550 ppm或450 ppm的若干成本效益较高的战略进行了定量评估。具体而言，本文分析了能够最优地实现这两个温室气体稳定化目标的能源投资和研发政策（即与将大气温室气体浓度稳定在550 ppm和450 ppm相一致的未来最优能源结构）。鉴于该模型考虑了世界12个区域之间的相互依存关系和溢出效应，最优战略是动态博弈的结果，通过该博弈可以评估全球战略互动所引起的效率损失。因此，我们的结果与以往关于温室气体稳定化政策的分析有所不同，以往分析通常假设存在中央计划者或单一全球经济体。特别是，本文考虑了搭便车激励对减排和研发投资的影响。由于WITCH模型中的技术变革是内生的，本文还评估了不同稳定化情景下能源部门技术演进的影响。最后，本文量化了将温室气体浓度稳定在不同水平、针对不同许可分配方案和不同技术情景下的净成本。在每种情况下，都确定了所有可用能源技术的最优长期投资战略。本文还分析了未知的后备能源技术的情形。

title: International energy R&D spillovers and the economics of greenhouse gas atmospheric stabilization
abstract: It is widely recognized that technological change has the potential to reduce GHG emissions without compromising economic growth; hence, any better understanding of the process of technological innovation is likely to increase our knowledge of mitigation possibilities and costs. This paper explores how international knowledge flows affect the dynamics of the domestic R&D sector and the main economic and environmental variables. The analysis is performed using WITCH, a dynamic regional model of the world economy, in which energy technical change is endogenous. The focus is on disembodied energy R&D international spillovers. The basic questions are as follows. Do knowledge spillovers enhance energy technological innovation in different regions of the world? Does the speed of innovation increase? Or do free-riding incentives prevail and international spillovers crowd out domestic R&D efforts? Our analysis shows that international knowledge spillovers tend to increase free-riding incentives and decrease the investments in energy R&D. The strongest cuts in energy R&D investments are recorded among High Income countries, where international knowledge flows crowd out domestic R&D efforts. The overall domestic pool of knowledge, and thus total net GHG stabilization costs, remain largely unaffected. We also analyze the implication of a policy mix in which climate policy is combined with a technology policy designed to enhance absorption capacity in developing countries. Significant positive impacts on the costs of stabilizing GHG concentrations are then singled out.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍认识到，技术变革有可能在不损害经济增长的前提下减少温室气体排放；因此，对技术创新过程的任何更深入理解，都可能增加我们对减缓可能性及其成本的认识。本文探讨国际知识流动如何影响国内研发部门的动态以及主要经济和环境变量。分析采用WITCH模型，这是一个动态的世界经济区域模型，其中能源技术变革是内生的。研究重点是非具身型能源研发的国际溢出效应。基本问题如下：知识溢出是否能增强世界各地区的能源技术创新？创新速度是否会加快？或者搭便车激励占据上风，国际溢出会挤出国内研发努力？我们的分析表明，国际知识溢出倾向于增强搭便车激励，并减少能源研发投资。能源研发投资削减最为明显的是高收入国家，那里的国际知识流动挤出了国内研发努力。国内知识存量总体而言，以及由此产生的温室气体稳定化总成本，基本未受影响。我们还分析了一种政策组合，即将气候政策与旨在增强发展中国家吸收能力的技术政策相结合。由此得出，这将对温室气体浓度稳定化的成本产生显著的正面影响。

title: National Through to Local Climate Policy in Italy
abstract: Italy, with 2% of the world's emissions and 13% of the European Union's emissions, has adopted a legally binding commitment to reduce its greenhouse gases emissions by 6.5% below 1990 levels by 2008 – 2012. This target will be reached by implementing both domestic policies (80%) and using the Kyoto mechanisms (20%). The success of the mitigation effort will depend on the coordination of policies at the national and local level and on the incentives and rewards given by the central government for the initiatives undertaken by local ones. This paper addresses the question: What climate change policies are being taken at national level and how are they implemented at or complemented by authorities at a local level? What lessons can one learn regarding the vertical interactions between governance levels in the area of climate change? This paper first examines national policy, the division of responsibilities with lower governments, an initiative to reduce emissions at the local level, and initiatives to deal with both adaptation and emission limitation in the highly vulnerable city of Venice. The paper concludes by drawing lessons for the future on the role of local governance on climate change.
abstract_zh: 意大利占世界排放量的2%，占欧盟排放量的13%，已承诺具有法律约束力的目标：在2008至2012年间将温室气体排放量较1990年水平降低6.5%。这一目标将通过实施国内政策（占80%）和利用《京都议定书》机制（占20%）来实现。减缓努力的成功将取决于国家和地方层面政策的协调，以及中央政府对地方政府所采取行动的激励和奖励。本文探讨以下问题：国家层面采取了哪些气候变化政策，这些政策如何在地方层面得到执行或得到地方当局的补充？从治理层级之间的纵向互动中，可以吸取哪些经验教训？本文首先考察国家政策、各级政府之间的责任划分、地方层面减排倡议，以及在高度脆弱的威尼斯市所采取的适应与减排并重的举措。文章最后就地方治理在气候变化中的作用总结了未来的经验教训。

title: The WITCH Model. Structure, Baseline, Solutions
A World Induced Technical Change Hybrid Model
